user.description: Configure access to the WD My Cloud API. Optional sleep-aware polling checks every disk over SSH and performs one full API poll per observed wake phase. Further active checks use cached values. The minimum update interval is {minimum_interval} seconds.

data_description.sleep_aware_enabled: Requires SSH and /usr/bin/hdparm on the NAS. Leave disabled for legacy behavior. Unknown states always block WD API polling when enabled.
data_description.ssh_password: Stored by Home Assistant. Use a dedicated credential where possible and restrict access to Home Assistant backups.

error.invalid_drive_devices: Enter unique whole-disk paths separated by commas, for example /dev/sda,/dev/sdc. Partitions and shell commands are not allowed.
error.connection: Unable to connect to the server.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Sleep-aware polling checks every configured drive with hdparm and performs one full WD API poll per observed wake phase. Further active checks use cached values until a non-active state is observed. The minimum update interval is {minimum_interval} seconds.

data_description.sleep_aware_enabled: Requires SSH and /usr/bin/hdparm on the NAS. Unknown states always block WD API polling.
data_description.ssh_password: Stored by Home Assistant. Use a dedicated credential where possible and restrict access to Home Assistant backups.
